items.title: Meta Ray-Ban Display smart glasses are getting smarter with a significant AI model upgrade
items.excerpt: Meta is upgrading its Ray-Ban Display glasses to its latest Muse Spark on-device AI model for smarter responses and better understanding of what the wearer sees, plus an extended Neural Handwriting feature that lets you invoke Meta AI by writing a prompt on any surface with your finger. A concrete on-device wearable-AI capability shift, not a rumor.

items.title: That Friend AI wearable you don't like just got worse
items.excerpt: Friend relaunched its AI companion pendant as a $249 device with a built-in speaker (so the AI talks back) and updated models, but now gates memory beyond 30 days behind a $10/month subscription. A new AI-native form factor for always-on personal AI. NOTE: content-dup with the Gizmodo Friend-pendant story already in news_data.

items.title: Jony Ive's first OpenAI hardware device sounds rather like ... a HomePad
items.excerpt: New reporting says the first OpenAI x Jony Ive consumer device is shaping up as a camera-equipped smart speaker with a display - an always-on, AI-native home device meant to be an ambient 'active participant.' A window into the first-gen AI-native hardware form factor. NOTE: content-dup with the MacRumors 'OpenAI first devices' story already in news_data.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Glasses are official: Snapdragon AR1, Gemini cross-app AI, 2 designer frames
items.excerpt: Samsung's Galaxy Glasses, unveiled at Unpacked in London, run on Qualcomm's Snapdragon AR1 with Google Gemini as the primary AI engine for real-time translation, live navigation, message summaries and hands-free capture, in Gentle Monster and Warby Parker frames. NOTE: content-dup with the Android Authority Samsung-Gemini-glasses story already in news_data.

items.title: Samsung's new foldables come with Gemini Notebook pre-installed
items.excerpt: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Flip 8 ship with Google's Gemini Notebook baked in - an AI research/notes surface that ingests your docs and turns them into summaries, audio overviews and study aids on-device-first, a distinct AI-tool angle beyond the usual Galaxy AI recap. Cleanest non-published pick of the Samsung Unpacked cluster.

items.title: Gemini Intelligence and Gemini Nano 4 launch with Galaxy Z Fold 8, Flip 8
items.excerpt: Samsung's new foldables are the first devices to ship Google's on-device Gemini Nano 4 model (140+ languages, better multimodal understanding) alongside the debut of Gemini Intelligence agentic task automation across 40+ apps. NOTE: content-dup with the Android Authority Gemini Nano 4 foldables story already in news_data.

items.title: Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Flip 8 lead the Gemini Intelligence rollout
items.excerpt: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Flip 8 are the launch vehicles for Gemini Intelligence, Google's agentic on-device Android layer that automates multi-step tasks across apps and the web directly on the phone. WITHIN-POOL dup with items 4/6 (Samsung Unpacked Gemini-on-device cluster).

items.title: Google's new Gemini Robotics 2 platform allows for 'intelligent whole-body control'
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 gives humanoid robots whole-body control (legs, torso, arms, 22-DOF hands) under one policy, with an embodied-reasoning 'brain' and an on-device variant that runs locally and adapts to new robot bodies in a few hours. Physical-AI hardware capability leap. NOTE: content-dup with the Verge Gemini Robotics 2 story already in news_data.
